name: jumanji-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Jumanji, a suite of reinforcement-learning environments written in JAX. This task
covers its core environment API (the `Environment` base class, timesteps and step types, specs, wrappers and the
environment registry) and its logic and packing environments: 2048, graph colouring, Minesweeper, Rubik's Cube, the
sliding tile puzzle, Sudoku, 3D bin packing, flat pack, job-shop scheduling, knapsack and Tetris, with their states,
observations, action masks, rewards, termination rules and instance generators.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is jumanji/__init__.py, jumanji/env.py, jumanji/types.py, jumanji/specs.py, jumanji/wrappers.py, jumanji/registration.py, jumanji/tree_utils.py, jumanji/environments/__init__.py and every Python module under jumanji/environments/logic/ and jumanji/environments/packing/ except the viewer.py modules, together with the documentation pages docs/environments/game_2048.md, docs/environments/graph_coloring.md, docs/environments/minesweeper.md, docs/environments/rubiks_cube.md, docs/environments/sliding_tile_puzzle.md, docs/environments/sudoku.md, docs/environments/bin_pack.md, docs/environments/flat_pack.md, docs/environments/job_shop.md, docs/environments/knapsack.md, docs/environments/tetris.md, docs/api/env.md, docs/api/types.md, docs/api/wrappers.md, docs/guides/advanced_usage.md, docs/guides/registration.md and docs/guides/wrappers.md, and the module, class
